title: License/Installation Check-In Request v1
description: LIVE as of Phase 6 -- POST /api/licensing/v1/check-ins (and its alias /activations/check). Matches app/licensing_service/checkin.py::REQUIRED_FIELDS exactly. Deliberately has NO license_key field -- authentication is via the device's already-registered Ed25519 key, not the license key (Principle 3).

installation_id.description: The SERVER-assigned public installation ID returned by the original activation response.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature, verified against the device's registered (not resubmitted) public key.
